meta.description: Vetted build + local preview of the site

user.t:
Build and locally preview the NeuroForge Bio marketing site. Working copy: C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\neuroforge\ . It is an Astro app at apps/web in a pnpm monorepo. Read ...\scratchpad\neuroforge-web-report.md first (the web lead listed exactly what the build/pins need). The owner has APPROVED this build + the owner-approved pin baselines.

SECURITY (standing rule — it's the user's own pinned repo, so this is reproducible, but still be careful):
1. FIRST, scan the repo's OWN package.json files for preinstall/postinstall/prepare lifecycle scripts (grep workspaces) and report any you find before installing. Do NOT install anything globally. Use the pinned lockfile only (pnpm-lock.yaml) — a FROZEN install, no version drift.
2. Prefer `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, SCOPED to the web app if possible (e.g. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter ./apps/web...`), to keep it light on a 16 GB box. If the Astro build then fails because a dependency needs its postinstall (esbuild/sharp platform binary), handle that narrowly (rebuild just that package) and report it — don't blanket-enable scripts without noting it.
3. No network beyond the package registry for the pinned deps. If anything tries to reach elsewhere, stop and report.

BUILD + PREVIEW:
4. Regenerate the homepage pins the web report requires (owner-approved): run the `home-baseline.mjs --owner-approved` and `homepage-pin-baseline.mjs --init` / `--owner-approved` scripts under apps/web/scripts as the report specifies.
5. Build apps/web (its build script). Report all errors/warnings. The `/arena` WASM bundle will NOT build here (needs the arena-wasm CI job + Rust wasm toolchain) — that page should honestly show "unavailable"; confirm it degrades gracefully, don't fake it.
6. Start a LOCAL preview server for the built site in the background on a fixed localhost port (use the repo's preview/serve script, e.g. `pnpm --filter ./apps/web preview` or scripts/serve.mjs) and report the exact http://localhost:PORT URL the owner can open on this machine. If a long-running server is impractical from here, instead report the built dist/ path and the single exact command the owner runs to preview.
7. If feasible without extra installs, run the content/a11y source checks; don't block on Playwright browser downloads.

Write a build report (what installed, scripts found, build result, pin status, preview URL/command, arena status, anything still broken) to ...\scratchpad\neuroforge-build-report.md and return a concise summary. Preserve honesty: no faked features, pre-product.

handback.t:
The NeuroForge web build succeeded for both themes and a local preview is running. The homepage Playwright pin was not created, and 7 dist tests fail.

**Preview (localhost only)**
- Clinical theme: http://127.0.0.1:4321/ (arena at http://127.0.0.1:4321/arena/)
- Cosmos theme: http://127.0.0.1:4322/
- Restart from apps/web with `node scripts/serve.mjs dist/clinical 4321` (the repo's own static server, which applies the build's `_headers`).
- Built output is in `apps/web/dist/clinical` and `apps/web/dist/cosmos`. The stage is `preview`, so pages are noindex by design.

**Security scan and install**
- None of the 14 package.json files has a preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare or prepublish script. The root sets `pnpm.onlyBuiltDependencies: []`.
- pnpm wasn't installed, so I ran the pinned `pnpm@9.15.0` through `npx -y`. Nothing was installed globally.
- The scoped install (`--filter "./apps/web..."`) didn't pull in `@nf/themes`' fontsource dependencies, so the first build failed. A frozen full-workspace install with `--ignore-scripts` fixed it (+96 packages).
- sharp and esbuild worked without their postinstall, so nothing was rebuilt. Only the npm registry was contacted.
- Node here is v24.19.0 and the repo wants >=22 <23. This only produced a pnpm engine warning.

**Build**
- `SITE_STAGE=preview node scripts/build.mjs` exited 0, with 37 pages per theme. copy-lint, figure verification and the CSP/inline checks were clean.
- The only warning is a Vite chunk over 500 kB (`interface-scene`, which is three.js).

**Pins**
- `home-baseline.mjs --owner-approved` is done. It rewrote the four `home-{css,html}.{clinical,cosmos}.txt` fixtures.
- `homepage-pin-baseline.mjs --init` is blocked. The working copy isn't a git repo ("no origin/main"), and no Playwright browsers are installed. I did not bypass this with `--owner-approved`. It needs to run in the real checkout with chromium.

**Arena**
- `/arena/` shows an honest "unavailable" state ("The live evaluator hasn't been published to this build yet."). It has no wasm footprint, is noindex and is out of the sitemap. The disclaimer and CTA still render, and the homepage links to it without loading the wasm bundle.
- The arena tests pass 26/26. The page needs the arena-wasm CI job to go live.

**Tests**
- Passing: content 38/38, ui 10/10, themes 14/14, copy-lint 14/14.
- The apps/web dist suite is 268 pass, 7 fail, 3 skipped. The failures are real source issues:
  1. `/gallery` has a broken `#decoding` link. The shared hero CTA in `home.json` uses `#decoding`, which only exists on `/`. It needs `/#decoding` or its own gallery CTA.
  2. `PlatformWorkflow.astro:39` puts an `aria-label` on a plain `<div>` with no role, on `/platform` and `/no/platform`. This may predate the changes, since there's no git baseline to compare.
  3. Six pages exceed their raw-HTML size budgets: `/arena`, `/docs`, `/docs/changelog`, `/interface`, `/platform` and `/playground`. The 8-item nav and the new strips likely caused it. Raising a budget is the owner's call.
- Playwright e2e, axe, visual and Lighthouse were not run. The manual eyeball list in the web report is still open: nav wrapping at 961–1100 px, cosmos contrast, and the latency chart at 320 px.

Still waiting on owner approval: removing the two stray workflow files.

Full report: `C:\Users\mariu\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\C--Users-mariu\8f3352b3-40ab-4151-abc9-d1de1978973c\scratchpad\neuroforge-build-report.md` (logs alongside it: `build.log`, `webtest.log`, `serve-clinical.log`, `serve-cosmos.log`).
